metadata.purpose: Generic governance baseline for any organization that wants attested decisions sealed, regardless of specific regulatory framework. Suitable as a starting profile that customers extend with framework-specific fields (HIPAA, GDPR, SOX, etc.).
metadata.intended_audience: Any organization using Verdifax to seal attested decisions where the audit trail must include who decided, under what authority, and why.
metadata.what_this_does: Refuses admission when the caller fails to declare actor identity, role, authorization basis, decision classification, or decision rationale. Produces a sealed AttestationGapReceipt naming the gap.
metadata.what_this_does_not_do: This profile makes no regulatory compliance claim. It is the minimum viable attested-decision floor, most regulated customers will inherit from this profile and add framework-specific fields on top.
